purpose: Draft a log entry for the owner's answers step of round 2 from a facts file Opus wrote. The draft stays in the scratchpad; Opus reads it before anything goes into the records.

instructions: Read the facts file. Do not open any other file.
Write draft.md: one paragraph, at most 180 words, beginning 'S104 (the owner's answers).' and saying, in plain terse words, what was written where and what the numbers became.
Use only the facts in the file: every number, id, md5, commit and file name must be copied from it. Add no reason, no judgement, no fact of your own.
Do not use these words: true, false, prove, proof, support, fit, verify, confirm, valid, correct, establish, derive, belief, authority, foundation.

check_steps.name: every fact-like token in the draft stands in the facts; words; S23 list

checks.name: no word on decision S23's list

on_fail: escalate to Opus with the draft and check.json
never: write into records/ or any file outside the out folder
